messages.subject: Re: combination of maps
parts:
I don't believe there's any discussion of combining maps in the R/qtl book.

There's a tutorial on genetic map construction (http://www.rqtl.org/tutorials/geneticmaps.pdf), but I don't think it touches on this aspect.

Do you have specific questions, or you just wondering about the capabilities of the software?

regards,
karl
